_comment: Your organisation's license policy. In real companies the legal team owns this file and the platform team enforces it. Ids are SPDX identifiers: https://spdx.org/licenses/

allow._why: Permissive: use, modify and ship it; just keep the copyright notice.

review._why: Weak copyleft or unclear: usually fine, but a human should check how we use it.

overrides._why: License metadata is sometimes wrong or missing. A human checked these by hand and recorded the evidence.

deny._why: Strong copyleft: shipping this inside our closed-source product could force us to publish our own source code.
